scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The probability parameter t is fixed and no statement is made beyond the log n/n window, relation signature or arc-independence assumptions. Critical half-reachability and model-theoretic limits are proved analytically; finite program is corroborative. Karp 1990 full text was inaccessible and historical priority remains conditional. Only self-review has been performed; independent audit has not been conducted.
title: Three-layer Poisson law and first-order convergence for random S4 reachability frames
